Definition: a vine (as twining), especially the grape
BiblicalUsage: The plain sense of gephen is vine, vine tree. It comes up 53 times, and the passages from Genesis, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and Judges show how steadily Scripture uses it. I do not find a second, secret meaning hiding behind it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that gephen matters because God tends His people the way a gardener tends a vine — patiently, and on purpose. I read this as a reminder that God’s words mean what they say, and I can trust them.
